answer_1.quote: In this work, we quantify and measure LLMs' us-ages of repetitive sequences in text generation.
answer_1.outputs: movie reviews, news summaries, biomedical systematic reviews, and synthetic text

answer_2.quote: We calculate three metrics using templates, (1) the diversity of the POS tags that are generated using CR-POS (2) the fraction of texts generated with a template using template rate and count, and (3) the number of templates that appear within each text using templates-per-token.
